Name: D8 · Passo Sella — 2,244 m
Notes: Crossed twice: D7 for the coffin gondola, D8 on the Great Dolomites Road. Sassolungo fills the windscreen the whole way up. 20 min from Selva. Free parking.

Name: D8 · Passo Pordoi — 2,239 m
Notes: D8, ~12:45. Sass Pordoi cable car above it almost certainly closed by mid-October — bonus, not a plan.

Name: D8 · Passo Falzarego — 2,105 m
Notes: D8 and D11. Free parking, and the base of the Lagazuoi cable car — the only lift still running in Cortina. Kept open through winter, so October is never in doubt.

Name: D8 · Passo Gardena — 2,121 m (short route + sunset)
Notes: The short-route alternative for D8. Also the best zero-effort sunset of the Val Gardena leg — Sassolungo framed by golden larches, 15 min from Selva.

Name: D8 · Passo Campolongo / Arabba — short route
Notes: On the short pass route (Gardena - Corvara - Campolongo - Arabba - Falzarego, 85 km, 2h45), the fallback if you skip Carezza and Canazei.

Name: D8 · Valley fallback — Val Pusteria via Dobbiaco
Notes: D8 SNOW FALLBACK. Ponte Gardena - A22 - Val Pusteria - Dobbiaco - SS51. 145 km, ~2h20 — actually FASTER on the clock than the passes, just far less beautiful. Check venetostrade.it and the Bolzano traffic portal that morning.

Name: D11 · Passo Giau — 2,236 m
Notes: D11 return leg. Come home over Giau on the SP638 instead of retracing Falzarego — same time, makes the day a loop. Bare amphitheatre under Ra Gusela and Nuvolau; larches rivalling Lago Federa. Rifugio Fedare at the top is OPEN YEAR-ROUND.
